description: Find tools for a task. Returns up to 5 matches with their COMPLETE input schemas, ready to pass to invoke(). Call with an empty query to see the category index.
name: discover

description: Run a tool found via discover(). `args` must match that tool's input_schema exactly. Returns {file: 'f_...'} when fast or {job: 'j_...'} when the work is still running.
name: invoke

description: Fetch a URL server-side and store it, returning a file handle. Every workflow starts here. Advertised natively because it is on the universal path.
name: file_from_url

description: Check a job returned by a slow tool. Status is running, done, failed or cancelled. Poll no faster than every 2 seconds.
name: job_status
